data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Kakao Map native platform services on Android, iOS, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a native platform-based Kakao Map view for Flutter applications. It enables camera movement control, markers (pois), custom shapes, routes, and overlays.
use_when: You need to integrate Kakao Map services into a Flutter app targeting Korea.
You require map overlays like Pois, shapes, and routes across Android and iOS.
avoid_when: you need standard global mapping solutions where Google Maps is preferred.
You rely heavily on advanced Web SDK features that are restricted or unimplemented in this plugin.
strengths: Supports native Kakao Maps for Android, iOS, and Web.
Rich set of graphical elements including Poi, shapes, routes, and dim screens.
Provides helper methods for hash keys on Android.
weaknesses: Web environment has limited support for certain features like camera rotation, tilt, and route patterns.
Requires specific manual configurations in AndroidManifest.xml and project files.
data.setup_notes: Requires app registration on Kakao Developers, native SDK initialization, Internet/Location permissions on Android, ProGuard rule updates, and adding script tags to web/index.html for web support.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need standard global mapping using Google Maps instead of Kakao Map.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a pure Dart map solution using OpenStreetMap tiles without native SDK setup.
